levels.surface: عبد الرحمن بن أبی عبد الله

notes: «عَمَّنْ رَوَاهُ» is a gap in the chain (rule 8): unnamed, at its place.
The Imam speaks in the words after the chain («قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ع»): last link, imam_in_text (owner ruling 2). The kunya «أبي عبد الله البرقي» is a different man and is a narrator.
The Persian «ی» is copied as the text writes it.
